text: Toto je můj kamarád / moje kamarádka
ipa: tˈoto je mˈuːj kˈamaraːt / mˈoje kˈamarˌaːtka
literal: kamarád(ka) rather than přítel(kyně), which in everyday spoken Czech reads as 'boyfriend/girlfriend' rather than a platonic friend

the place name takes the genitive case after z -- 'z Ameriky', 'z Německa' -- which a bare slot cannot inflect for every filler; this is a known limitation shared with the other case-marking Slavic packs
